info.name: Collab-Docs API (Complete)
info.description: Complete API collection for Collab-Docs application. Includes Spring Boot backend (port 8080) and Node.js Yjs Service (port 3000) endpoints. Real-time collaboration via WebSocket: ws://localhost:3000/ws/yjs/{yjsRoomId}?token={jwt}

request.description: Initiate user registration. Sends OTP to email for verification.
Complete registration by verifying OTP sent to email
Resend verification OTP to email
Authenticate user and receive JWT token in HttpOnly cookie
Request password reset OTP
Reset password using OTP
Logout user and clear JWT cookie
Get currently authenticated user information
Refresh JWT token
Validate current JWT token
Get a specific document by ID
Get paginated list of user's documents
Create a new blank HTML document
Upload DOCX or PDF file. Content is extracted and converted to HTML.
Change document visibility (PRIVATE, SHARED, PUBLIC)
Soft delete a document. Only owner can delete.
Save Yjs CRDT snapshot to PostgreSQL. Internal service call from Node.js yjs-service. Accepts binary snapshot data (byte array) with Content-Type: application/octet-stream.

Get Yjs CRDT snapshot from PostgreSQL. Internal service call from Node.js yjs-service. Returns binary data with Content-Type: application/octet-stream (200 OK) or 204 No Content for new documents without snapshots.
Grant access to a document for another user. Only OWNER can add collaborators. Role can be OWNER, EDITOR, or VIEWER. expiresInDays is optional (null = permanent access).
Get all collaborators for a document. Any user with access can view the list. Returns array of collaborators with user details, roles, and timestamps.
Update a collaborator's role. Only OWNER can update roles. Cannot demote the last OWNER.
Revoke a user's access to a document. Only OWNER can remove collaborators. Cannot remove the last OWNER.

item.name: Document Versioning

request.description: Create a new version snapshot of the current document state. Requires EDITOR permission or higher. Captures both Yjs binary snapshot and content. Optional versionName and changeNotes for better tracking.
List all versions for a document with metadata. Requires VIEWER permission or higher. Returns versions ordered by version number descending (newest first).
List versions with pagination. Useful for documents with many versions. Returns Page object with content, pagination details, and total counts.
Get a specific version with its content snapshot. Requires VIEWER permission on the document. Returns both Yjs binary snapshot and content snapshot for viewing or restoration.

Restore a document to a previous version. This creates a NEW version with the old content rather than overwriting history. Requires EDITOR permission or higher. Updates both PostgreSQL and Yjs service.
Delete a specific version. Requires OWNER permission. Cannot delete if it's the only version (at least one version must remain for audit purposes).

query.description: Number of recent versions to keep

request.description: Delete old versions keeping only N most recent. Requires OWNER permission. Useful for storage management and enforcing quotas. Default keepCount is 10.
Get version count and storage usage for a document. Requires VIEWER permission or higher. Returns version count, total storage in bytes, and formatted storage string.

item.description: Document version control and history management. Create snapshots, restore previous versions, and manage version storage. Full RBAC integration with VIEWER/EDITOR/OWNER permissions.

item.name: Sharing
Share Links

request.description: Create a shareable link for a document. Requires EDITOR or OWNER permission. Can grant VIEWER or EDITOR role (not OWNER). Optional expiration and usage limits.

query.description: Filter to show only active links

request.description: Get all share links for a document. Requires VIEWER permission. Use activeOnly=true to filter expired/revoked links.
Validate if a share link is valid. PUBLIC endpoint - no authentication required. Returns link details without granting access.

Grant permanent access to a document via share link.

**Flow (Option 2: Force Registration):**
1. Unauthenticated user clicks share link
2. Frontend shows login/register page
3. After authentication, user is redirected to this endpoint
4. Backend creates permanent DocumentPermission
5. Returns document details (ID, title, yjsRoomId, role, owner)

**Authentication:** Required (JWT token in cookie)
**Response:** DocumentAccessResponse with document details
**Side Effects:** Creates permission record, increments usage counter
Deactivate a share link. Can be done by link creator or document owner. Link is marked inactive but not deleted (for audit trail).
Permanently delete a share link. Can be done by link creator or document owner. Use revoke instead to preserve audit trail.

item.description: Share document access via secure, customizable links. Support for expiration, usage limits, authentication requirements, and audit trail.

item.name: Email Invitations

request.description: Send a collaboration invitation via email. Requires EDITOR or OWNER permission. Email sent with accept/decline links. Expires after 7 days.
Get all invitations for a document (pending, accepted, declined). Requires VIEWER permission or higher.
Get all pending invitations for the current authenticated user. Shows invitations sent to their email address.
Accept a collaboration invitation. Creates document permission and marks invitation as accepted. User's email must match invitation.
Decline a collaboration invitation. Marks invitation as declined. User's email must match invitation.
Revoke a pending invitation. Can be done by invitation sender or document owner. Marks invitation as revoked.

item.description: Send direct email invitations to specific users. Invitations require acceptance and automatically create permissions. Support for pending, accepted, declined, and expired states.
Document sharing system with two methods: shareable links (public/authenticated) and email invitations (direct). Both support role-based permissions (VIEWER/EDITOR), expiration, and audit trails.
